Dolly Parton will be honored with a special musical tribute at this year’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, which celebrates its historic 100th edition on Saturday after being postponed from Thanksgiving Day due to weather conditions.

Tony-nominated Broadway star Megan Hilty will lead the tribute to the country music icon, who died in August at age 80. The performance is among several high-profile musical numbers planned for the milestone celebration, alongside appearances from RAYE, Teddy Swims, Megan Moroney, Queen Latifah and “KPop Demon Hunters” breakout EJAE.

The 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade will air Saturday, Nov. 28, from 8:30 a.m. to noon in all time zones on NBC and Telemundo, with an encore presentation on NBC at 2 p.m. ET/PT. Those without cable can stream the festivities live on Peacock, in addition to a variety of live TV streaming services that carry NBC, including DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV and Sling TV in select markets.

“Today” show personalities Savannah Guthrie, Hoda Kotb and Al Roker will return to host the Emmy-winning telecast.

The parade’s 100th edition coincides with NBC’s own centennial anniversary, marking a particularly significant year for the network. More than 11,000 volunteers and participants will descend on Manhattan for Thursday’s festivities, which will span 2.5 miles from the Upper West Side to Macy’s flagship store in Herald Square. In a nod to the anniversary, Macy’s has assembled a record 100 inflatable creations, including new balloons depicting Bluey, Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey Mouse and Snoopy’s Joe Cool alter ego. The parade will also bring back balloons designed by some of the art world’s biggest names, including Tim Burton, Keith Haring, Jeff Koons and Yayoi Kusama.

Hollywood will be well represented among this year’s new floats, too, including a Hogwarts-themed creation from HBO. A commemorative Macy’s All Stars float will bring together familiar characters from throughout the parade’s history, from Bugs Bunny and Scooby-Doo to Sonic the Hedgehog.

Broadway, a fixture of the annual telecast, will get an expanded showcase this year. A 10-minute musical medley introduced by Julianne Hough will bring together performers from nine productions, including “Hamilton,” “Wicked,” “Rent,” “Chicago,” “The Book of Mormon,” “Aladdin,” “Schmigadoon!,” “The Lost Boys” and “The Rocky Horror Show.”

Other musical performers on this year’s roster include Natasha Bedingfield, Jimmy Fallon and the Roots, Keke Palmer, JoJo, Wyclef Jean, Leslie Odom Jr., Anthony Ramos, Indigo Girls, DEVO, Smash Mouth and K-pop boy band RIIZE. The Radio City Rockettes will also return before Santa Claus closes out the festivities.

Stream the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade live on Peacock, or watch for free with an eligible streaming trial through DirecTV.

11 月 21 日，Red Hook Studios 在 WePlay 主舞台首次公开了《暗黑地牢 II》全新付费 DLC《The Butcher’s Asylum》的完整预告片，并展示了加长实机演示。DLC 计划于 2027 年初推出，将率先登陆 PC，之后登陆主机平台。

《The Butcher’s Asylum》将带来全新的独立角斗场模式。玩家需要组建英雄小队，在观众的注视下迎战一波又一波敌人。来自《暗黑地牢 II》罪状模式和 王国模式的敌人将以全新组合登场，玩家需要根据每一波敌人的情况调整战术，坚持到队伍落败为止。

新模式还加入了观众情绪度与奖品转盘机制。玩家可以及时满足观众的要求，赢得战斗增益与强力能力；每轮结束后，也能凭表现获得门票，在转盘上兑换奖励。奖励包括怪癖、饰品、道途解锁内容、主题英雄配色与战斗修正项。

初代《暗黑地牢》DLC《屠夫马戏团》中登场的竞技场大师（The Ringmaster）也将成为可玩英雄。玩家可在《The Butcher’s Asylum》中解锁她，并在《暗黑地牢 II》的三种模式中使用。她是游戏中的第 16 位可玩英雄，擅长造成流血效果，采用高风险、高回报的进攻风格。

《The Butcher’s Asylum》还将由全新配音演员担任旁白。新旁白仅出现在该模式中，不会影响此前推出的Confessions 和 Kingdoms模式。

items.content:
中新网杭州11月28日电(曹丹)11月27日，“案藏联韵——楹联档案文化展”在浙江省档案馆开展。展览以“档案里的楹联、楹联里的档案”为主轴，甄选70余幅楹联佳作，分为“两浙存联，一脉长延”“家国史怀，丹心永固”“新联焕彩，共富宏图”“档呈翰韵，明鉴春秋”四个篇章。

楹联是中华优秀传统文化的瑰宝，融文学意趣、书法艺术与民俗内涵于一体。档案则是历史记忆的真实载体，镌刻着文化传承和时代发展的深厚根基。

浙江省诗词与楹联学会会长王骏表示，双方联合举办楹联档案文化展等一系列活动，对激活档案文化资源的时代价值、推动楹联文化的普及传播起到了积极促进作用。

展厅里，一副左宗棠行书七言联前不时有观众驻足。“经济以诗书为鹄；文章得山海之华”，这副自勉联为左宗棠一生治学理念的写照，现藏于浙江省档案馆。其行书雄健豪迈，笔力刚劲，结体开张，气势沉雄。

一旁，梁启超的一副集字联“远载素书问黄石；自犁南雪种来禽”则集《张迁碑》字而成。其书法得《张迁碑》古拙雄浑之风，结体方整，笔致朴厚。

除左宗棠、梁启超外，展览还展出朱熹、伊秉绶、蔡元培、马一浮等历代名家与近代先贤的馆藏珍品。

“千百年来，两浙大地文风鼎盛，楹联不仅是供人品鉴的书法艺术，更是凝结历史记忆的珍贵档案。”浙江省档案馆馆长王利月说，希望以此次展览为契机，持续加大馆藏资源的深挖活化力度，搭建更多跨界融合的文化平台，让沉睡的档案真正活起来、用起来。

开展仪式上，浙江省诗词与楹联学会的吟诵者还深情吟唱了《纪念长征胜利九十周年》《山水的眷恋》《赏〈嘉禾八景图〉之东塔朝暾》等诗词作品。(完)

欢迎来到「本月玩什么」，本栏目将从作者个人角度出发，独立挑选一些本月新发售的游戏作品/内容做简要介绍、评论，不保证收录覆盖面，且并非每一款都是笔者推荐游玩的，主要涵盖 PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo、PC 和 iOS/Android 等主流平台；请注意，本文的探讨仅限于游戏刚发售时点的表现，游戏未来可能通过迭代变得更好或更差。期待这里能有勾起你兴趣的内容或探讨，也真诚感谢所有喜欢本栏目的朋友。

虹吸全游戏行业的巨无霸，带来迄今为止不一定最胡闹、但一定是最恢宏的模拟世界。

Take-Two 发行、Rockstar Games 出品，Grand Theft Auto V 首发十三年后终于到来，也是 Rockstar 联合创始人兼御用主笔 Dan Houser 2020 年离职之后，第一部没有他参与主导的《GTA》系列正作。

据 Take-Two 发布的数据，本作发售前预购量即达 3250 万套，发售当天全球零售额冲上 37.9 亿美元，刷新了单一娱乐产品的首发纪录。

《卫报》在其发售前体验感想中回顾了系列的创业历史：Rockstar North 的前身、成立于苏格兰邓迪的 DMA Design，1997 年推出了 GTA 初代，以俯视角描绘了虚构美国都市下的警匪追逐。据当年的主创回忆，项目每周都面临被海外发行方砍掉的风险，团队穷到连去美国实地采风的预算都没有、工作室只有一台电脑能上网，得靠大量摄入书、影、音等各式各样的媒体，来脑补出那个狂野的平行宇宙美国。此后近 30 年里，GTA 以纽约、迈阿密、洛杉矶、旧金山、拉斯维加斯等知名美国城市为蓝本，构建起愈发生动、拟真的犯罪故事舞台，直到今天我们终于能体验到系列的集大成者 GTA VI，这次供玩家大展拳脚的，是脱胎于佛罗里达州的“雷奥奈达”（Leonida），包括了 GTA IV 老玩家阔别多年的「罪恶都市」（Vice City）。

GTA VI 叙事上借鉴了经典电影《雌雄大盗》（Bonnie and Clyde），围绕有军人背景的男主 Jason Duval、刚假释出狱的女主 Lucia Caminos 展开。和有多位可操作主角的 GTA V 类似，本作也支持两位主角间的无缝切换（序幕中受限），玩家不控制的一方会自主按照作息行动，或者是响应玩家主控角色提出的交互，比如有事没事互发短信、一起健个身、拜托对方去销赃之类的。

GTA 系列的体验一直很强调拟真，玩家会身处于一座庞大且生动的城市（每一代 GTA 几乎都站在时代的前沿），一般来说，你可以顺着主线体验电影化、紧凑的故事——当然几乎都在犯事，也可以试着模拟某种生活，闲逛、消费、享受海陆空三栖游乐项目、完成啼笑皆非的支线委托、成为城市丛林里无法无天的兰博，尽管随心所欲。在营造庞大、精致、真实的世界这一点上，GTA VI 在全系列无疑登峰造极，且不单纯是前作的「超级加倍」，还吸收了《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》（Red Dead Redemption 2）在拟真方面的探索，比如：

与这些机制调整相伴的，是本作氛围的显著变化。玩家可能带着大开杀戒的预期而来，却发现自己栽进了一部「美国底层阶级：游戏版」装修爱巢、准备礼物、锻炼身体、跑腿催债、银行开户、对付逾期账单、被线上平台封号……Game Developer 称此为「日常琐事感」（Mundanity）在大作里的回潮，本想亡命天涯、却活出了一种蓝领阶层的柴米油盐味。笔者玩得非常慢，目前还在第一章到处探索，我一贯不着急在开放世界游戏里推主线，何况这是满大街都能杀出程咬金的 GTA。所以，对于游戏氛围变化的看法，我还需要更多深入游玩来沉淀。

我倒是想再聊聊发售前、刚上手这段时间，对《GTA VI》的更笼统印象。这部作品给了我很强的「矛盾感」，戏里戏外都是：

某种程度上，我也在以这种充满矛盾的心态接纳这部作品：我相信它会是我玩过的细节最缜密的游戏之一，探索的欲望驱使着我继续，与此同时，尽管可以理解，但主角的价值观中也有很多我不认同的地方。总之我就准备这么边想边玩下去。

items.originalContent:
Executive Editor, Legal, Labor & Politics

Christmas came on Thanksgiving for Netflix‘s The Hunting Wives, thanks to a fatuous Donald Trump Jr.

Never slow to put his silver foot in his big mouth, the oldest and most ambitious son of El Presidente got very hot under the digital collar early on Turkey Day over a passionate promo for the soapy and streamy MAGA themed series of two women kissing.

In proclaiming “What is wrong with you??? It’s Thanksgiving” on X on November 26 in reply to Netflix, the no stranger to controversy and speculation Don Jr. looks to have handed the Season 2 launch of the Rebecca Cutter created show the kind of publicity even Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters‘ well-funded team can’t buy.

What is wrong with you??? It’s Thanksgiving.

While the First Louche’s outrage may have struck some as reeking of hypocrisy, or at least lacking all self-awareness, the fact is Don Jr’s tweet has been viewed over 7.5 million times since Thanksgiving morning. Add to that, a flood of media coverage from the highbrow to the gutter press and (we see you Fox News) everything in-between and you have yourself a good old fashion water cooler moment.

Starring Brittany Snow and Malin Åkerman as Sophie and Margo, a East Coastnewcomer to an East Texas town and the town’s leading lady, The Hunting Wives, which is based on the May Cobb novel of the same name. With guns, booze, short leather skirts, cowboy boots, MAGA, murder and lot of sex, the show follows Sophie as loses more and more of her old Boston life and more intimate with the scheming Margo, who’s Dermot Mulroney portrayed oil tycoon husband is running for Lone Star State Governor.

Hunting Wives scribe Brandon Zuck took out a shiv of his own against Don Jr. on Instagram, as well as delivering a backhanded compliment. “Just wait until season 3,” he wrote on his IG Story next to a screen shot of Junior’s tweet. That echoes what Cutter said when Netflix announced Season 3 last month. “Buckle up, because Season 3 will be even more scandalous and twisted,” the showrunner stated.

Further add to Jr’s ill-considered pearl clutching, the fact the actual online clip of Snow and Åkerman’s characters making out has itself claimed 36 million views on the (MAGA? Not MAGA?) Elon Musk-owned platform. All of which means the Streisand effect of Little Don’s post cannot have been helpful in pushing Hunting Wives Season 2’s eight episode debt to number #3 in the Netflix charts in less than 24 hours.

Likely not wanting to throw cold water on a good firestorm, Netflix did not respond to Deadline’s request for comment on Little Don’s tweet and the backlash it’s received. But, why would they? As WME Ari’s brother, former White House Chief of Staff and budding 2028 candidate Rahm Emanuel once said: “You never want a serious crisis to go to waste.”

items.content:
2001 年，三部电影以截然不同的方式挑战了印地语电影的熟悉惯例。

法尔汉·阿赫塔尔 (Farhan Akhtar) 的《Dil Chahta Hai》为友谊和年轻人提供了一种新的屏幕语言；阿舒托什·戈瓦里克 (Ashutosh Gowariker) 的《Lagaan》将一场乡村板球比赛变成了一部关于反抗的史诗； Madhur Bhandarkar 的“Chandni Bar”将观众带入了孟买舞厅中鲜为人知的世界。 25 年后，电影制片人在第 57 届国际电影节的“传奇 25 岁”会议上重新审视了这些电影及其背后的风险。

有一条线索将他们的故事联系在一起：三人都曾遭遇过商业印地语电影的期望，然后才找到了做出不同的东西的信念。

在“Lagaan”和“Chandni Bar”确立电影制作人的身份之前，Gowariker 和 Bhandarkar 就已经拍摄过电影。阿赫塔尔以《Dil Chahta Hai》作为他的导演处女作，他表示他对制作一部符合宝莱坞流行的粗制滥造模板的电影不感兴趣。

In 2001, three films challenged familiar conventions of Hindi-language cinema in very different ways.

Farhan Akhtar‘s “Dil Chahta Hai” offered a new screen language for friendship and young adulthood; Ashutosh Gowariker‘s “Lagaan” turned a village cricket match into an epic about resistance; and Madhur Bhandarkar’s “Chandni Bar” took audiences into the largely unseen world of Mumbai’s dance bars. Twenty-five years later, the filmmakers revisited the films and the risks behind them at “The Legendary 25s,” a session at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa moderated by actor and producer Khushboo Sundar.

One thread connected their stories: all three had encountered the expectations of commercial Hindi cinema before finding the conviction to make something different.

Gowariker and Bhandarkar already had films behind them before “Lagaan” and “Chandni Bar” established their identities as filmmakers. Akhtar, making his directorial debut with “Dil Chahta Hai,” said he had not been interested in making a film that conformed to the prevailing Bollywood potboiler template.

For Gowariker, who is also the IFFI festival director this year, the turning point came after his first two films failed. Having initially tried to make commercial entertainers, he realized that “my next film had to be something I believe in, something that I want to make first, and then hope to God that the audience also likes it. So that’s how the genesis of ‘Lagaan’ happened.”

The idea was an unlikely proposition: a period drama built around a cricket match, with villagers taking on the British. Gowariker wanted to make a film about “a group of heroes.” He researched the British Raj, 19th-century life, cricket and village communities before taking the script back to star Aamir Khan, who had initially rejected the premise. Gowariker asked Khan for just three hours to hear the narration of “Lagaan” before deciding. “He heard it. He laughed, he had tears and he said, ‘I definitely want to do this now,'” Gowariker recalled of the film, which went on to receive an Oscar nomination.

Bhandarkar’s route to “Chandni Bar” was rooted in observation. A visit to a dance bar with a friend gave him the subject for the Tabu-starring film, which he researched by visiting bars across Mumbai for six months. “Even if, in retrospect, ‘Chandni Bar’ had not done well at the box office, I would still be happy because this is the cinema which I wanted to make, and this is the world which I’ve seen,” he said.

His interest in underdogs has continued in films such as “Page 3,” “Corporate” and “Fashion,” which examined the worlds of the media, business and fashion respectively. He has also resisted pressure to turn women-centered stories into male-led films for commercial reasons. From Tabu’s vulnerable character in “Chandni Bar” to Raveena Tandon’s politically ambitious woman in “Satta,” he said he is drawn to complex women rather than idealized portrayals. “My movies are basically a mirror to society,” he said.

With “Dil Chahta Hai,” a buddy movie starring Aamir Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna, Akhtar set out to bring a more recognizable version of friendship to the screen. He felt Hindi films’ depictions of male friendship did not reflect how people actually spent time together. “The relationship had become cheesy, filmy,” he said. He cited Mansoor Khan’s “Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak” (1988), which he watched as a schoolboy, as an important influence.

Asked specifically about the older-woman romance in “Dil Chahta Hai,” he said the inspiration for the relationship between the characters played by Akshaye Khanna and Dimple Kapadia came “from many crushes that I had on older women, that’s the honest truth.”

Thursday was a dual celebration for Justin Timberlake‘s visit with Jimmy Fallon on NBC’s Tonight Show: There was Thanksgiving, of course, which you can see in the photo above was most certainly not ignored by the two old friends, and then for the former boy bander the visit was an opportunity to celebrate the 20th anniversary of his album FutureSex/LoveSounds.

And of course there’s always new material to plug, and last night it was Timberlake‘s four-part doc series streaming on Apple TV beginning December 11.

The Thanksgiving visit began with Timberlake joining Fallon in a musical number celebrating “The History of Party Songs.” With Timberlake initially putting up some mock reluctance, the two then launched into Soul II Soul’s “Back to Life (However Do You Want Me),” then proceeded through a smorgasbord of classic dance hits, including Ini Kamoze’s “Here Comes the Hotstepper,” Mark Morrison’s “Return of the Mack,” Montell Jordan’s “This Is How We Do It,” Spice Girls “Wannabe,” Bell Biv DeVoe’s “Poison,” Timberlake’s own “Rock Your Body,” Wild Cherry’s “Play That Funky Music White Boy,” “Good Times” by Chic, Cool and the Gang’s “Celebration,” and some others you might be able catch before the big finish of The Backstreet Boys’ “I Want It That Way.”

Timberlake also reflected on the making of the FutureSex/LoveSounds album, noting that at the time of its recording he’d been listening to “Bowie, David Byrne, Talking Heads, Freddie Mercury, Queen, Billy Idol, James Brown, Eurythmics, INXS…but we were kind of thinking, How we can take the sonics of dance music and flip it?”

Timberlake recalls that, as presented in the upcoming docuseries, his record label at the time was not initially impressed with the album, thinking it was “too fast,” to which Timberlake responded, “That’s why it’s going to work.” He also remembered that the label was disappointed that he wasn’t using his signature falsetto enough. “I was listening to [David Bowie’s] ‘Rebel Rebel’ a lot…and that music at that time sounded so daring.” Timberlake says he wanted to create the impression that the singer was a character in the song, as Bowie so often did, and the result was “SexyBack.”

Regarding the upcoming four-part Timberlake documentary series, the singer explained that he overcame his initial reluctance – “I’m sort of famously private” – by trusting director and friend Fisher Stevens. “I feel like I’ve gone through a lot in the last five years that made me a better human,” he said.

“But the more we sat down and talked, the more I found myself searching for something that was beneath the surface a little more,” he continued. “And I think that at the end of the day I sort of mustered up some courage to talk about things that I’ve never talked about before. Things that even those that are closest to me don’t know.”

Timberlake also paid tribute to the late singer-songwriter D’Angelo, the major influence who died October 14, 2025. “D’Angelo, for me, he changed everything,” Timberlake told Fallon. “You know, he was one of those artists. Rest in peace. What a brilliant, brilliant, brilliant artist. But I remember when he came out, it just like everything changed. [He] was a once-in-a-generation artist.”

And finally, here’s Timberlake’s performance that capped the Fallon appearance, taking place at New York’s famed Rainbow Room atop 30 Rock. He performs a medley of “FutureSex/LoveSound,” “SexyBack,” “Summer Love” and “My Love.”

The docuseries Timberlake airs on Apple TV on Friday, December 11 with the first two episodes, followed by the third episode on Friday, December 18 and the finale on Wednesday, December 23, 2026.

Editorial Director/Box Office Editor

On today’s Crew Call we chat with near EGOT winner David Byrne about “Let Me Sell You A Dream,” his new song for Alex Gibney’s controversial documentary Musk about, yes, Elon Musk.

Byrne tells us about co-writing the ditty during the European leg of his latest tour “Who is the Sky?” and biking to a London musical equipment shop to get recording gear, so he could create a makeshift studio in his hotel room and lay down tracks for Oscar nominated composer Daniel Pemberton, who is a co-writer on the song.

In recording the tune, Byrne exclaims, “I’d sit at my little mic stand in a hotel room and I’d go into character as Elon Musk (exhale), and just start ranting.”

Off the bat, “Let Me Sell You a Dream” in its fast dance tempo brings to mind the 1986 Talking Heads single “Wild Wild Life” which Byrne wrote for the Warner Bros absurdist reality movie he directed and co-wrote, True Stories.

Byrne says that “Let Me Sell You a Dream” had to be “hard hitting…It’s going to have an impact at the at the end. It has to jump right in, and grab you by the throat.”

“It’s not one of those fading-while-the-credits roll and everybody decides, ‘I’m going to get up, get out and get back to my car before everybody else.'”

“Let Me Sell You a Dream” is also throwback to the types of pseudo anti-yuppie tunes that Talking Heads was known for including 1988’s “(Nothing) But Flowers” and 1979’s “Life During Wartime”. Byrne explains that the Musk end-credits song was arguably the “fastest” he has ever written in his career. To date, while Musk has railed against Gibney about the documentary, he hasn’t sent any praise or tomatoes to the Oscar winning Byrne. Give a listen to Byrne’s process here:

Byrne also takes us down memory regaling that his first instrument was a violin, and how he grew up inspired by The Rolling Stones and Motown. He also chats about the early days of the Talking Heads when they were discovered by Sire Records’ boss Seymour Stein (“He could meet with us, talk with us and and sing ours songs back to us”) as well as working with Bernardo Bertolucci and producer Jeremy Thomas on the score for The Last Emperor which won Byrne an original score Oscar which he co-shared with Cong Su and Ryūichi Sakamoto.

A time when Byrne was told by the music industry he was too audacious? How about when he did his first solo album in 1989, the Latino infused “Rei Momo”?

Senior International Film Correspondent

Chinese director Zou Jing’s A Girl Unknown won the top $75,000 Best Narrative prize at the Doha Film Festival as the second edition of its revamped format came to a close on Friday evening.

The China-set first feature follows the fate of a young girl who is found abandoned as a baby in a rubbish bin and then grows up from babyhood through to adolescence with three sets of different guardians and circumstances.

The film world premiered in Cannes Critics’ Week earlier this year where it won the Fipresci Prize. The picture was acquired for the U.S. by Greenwich Entertainment which is planning an early 2027 tour and release.

Rafael Manuel won Best Artistic Achievement in Narrative for Filipiñana about a 17-year-old girl who discovers a rotten side to the posh countryclub where she works on the golf course. The film world premiered in Sundance, where it won the World Cinema Special Jury Award. The film is the Philippines’ entry for the 99th Academy Awards.

Best Actress was awarded posthumously to Josette Kwanya for her performance in her son Auguste Bernard Kouemo’s House of the Wind as an elderly Cameroonian woman waiting for her children to return home after they left for Europe in search of fresh life opportunities.

The film won Venice’s Lion of the Future for a Debut Film when it premiered there in its Orizzonti sidebar in September.

This year’s jury was presided over by Japanese director Naomi Kawase, who was joined by by Oscar-winning documentarian Gianfranco Rosi, rising actor Adam Bessa, Tunisian producer Dora Bouchoucha and Palestinian director Kamal Aljafari.

In further prizes, Best Documentary went to Asmahan Bkerat’s Concrete Land about a Bedouin family struggling to preserve their traditional way of life in tents, as well as the Fipresci prize, which is being awarded at the festival for the first time this year.

In other documentary prizes, Tala Hadid’s Bardi won the Best Artistic Achievement for Documentary.

Marvel veteran Sebastian Stan is sticking up for last year’s “Thunderbolts,” despite it being one of the lowest-grossing MCU movies.

In the team-up movie, he reprised his role as Bucky Barnes, aka the Winter Soldier, alongside Florence Pugh as Yelena Belova and David Harbour as the Red Guardian to form the Thunderbolts, a new group in the MCU. They later renamed themselves the New Avengers, made up of Wyatt Russell as U.S. Agent, Lewis Pullman as Sentry and Hannah John-Kamen as Ghost, and the team will return in next month’s “Avengers: Doomsday.”

After releasing in May 2025, “Thunderbolts” ended its box office run with $382 million worldwide, ranking as the fifth lowest total out of all 38 MCU films. The only movies below it are “Black Widow” ($379 million), “Captain America: The First Avenger” ($370 million), “The Incredible Hulk” ($264 million) and “The Marvels” ($206 million). They’re all a far cry from this summer’s “Spider-Man: Brand New Day,” which is the second biggest MCU movie with $2.5 billion (behind the highest-grossing film ever, “Avengers: Endgame” with $2.94 billion).

“I think it’s just when you’ve had a studio and you’ve had Marvel and it’s been so many years where they’ve just been knocking it out of the park, $350 million global, something like that, it just suddenly doesn’t seem that much,” Stan said on “Next Best Picture.” “But it’s insane how much money that is.”

He added, “For us, it felt like a success. I know a lot of care went into that and it had more nuance to it in terms of some of the recent ones, from my point of view at least, dealing with real issues like mental health and depression and so on.”

“Thunderbolts” was praised by fans and critics for its darker tone and how it elevated its cast of misfit, lesser-known characters. Its director, Jake Schreier, was tapped by Marvel to helm its 2028 “X-Men” movie, with a cast including Sadie Sink, Adam Driver, Inde Navarrette, Kit Connor and more.

Monica Bellucci, the glamorous Italian star who broke through internationally with “Malena” and “Irreversible,” was 50 when she made James Bond history as the oldest woman to play a Bond girl in Sam Mendes’ “Spectre.”

But rather than marking the twilight of her career as a Hollywood sex symbol, the movie ushered in a new chapter for Bellucci whose career has been enjoying a second wind in recent years.

During a candid, wide-ranging masterclass moderated by Variety at the Marrakech Film Festival, Bellucci recalled that Mendes really “wanted to show a mature woman, and I thought it was a beautiful idea.” “He told me, ‘Listen, I have a strong and unusual role that’s going to be surprising, a little revolutionary,” she said. “I was 50, and I had never seen a 50-year-old Bond woman. So I think I’m the oldest James Bond woman, lady or girl that we’ve ever seen,” Bellucci said with a laugh in front of a huge crowd of locals and film students who queued for over two hours to get in.

Ultimately, “Spectre” and Emir Kusturica’s “On the Milky Road,” in which she starred opposite the Serbian filmmaker, came at a pivotal moment in her life.

“Suddenly, I had two very strong roles. Those two films helped me get through the transition of turning 50, which wasn’t easy for an actress,” she said.

Bellucci, whose body of work has largely been shaped by celebrated male auteurs — from Francis Ford Coppola to Giuseppe Tornatore, Gaspar Noé and David Lynch — also noted that she has enjoyed working with more female directors in recent years. She cited Alice Rohrwacher with her Cannes-prizewinning “The Wonders,” Rebecca Miller with “The Private Lives of Pippa Lee,” Kaouther Ben Hania with “The Man Who Sold His Skin” and Léa Mysius’ “Birthday Girl,” which competed at this year’s Cannes.

“When I was younger, there weren’t as many female directors as there are today. It’s new to have so many female directors, screenwriters and even technicians on a set, so many women. We’re witnessing something completely new,” she said.

“It’s another way of telling stories, sometimes another vision. And between women, sometimes there’s this ‘je ne sais quoi,’ as we say in France. Suddenly, we look at each other and, without words, we express ourselves and we understand each other. So I also really like working with women whenever possible.”

Bellucci said the roles she is being offered have also evolved as she’s gotten older, allowing her to explore facets of herself that she couldn’t have accessed earlier in her career.

“Our body is our working instrument. So the instrument changes and, consequently, the roles change. It’s another part of ourselves that’s expressing itself,” she said. “As we get older, we also gain experience, and we have another way of telling the story of life.”

items.summary: 中新网11月27日电 11月26日，“2026北京国际视听大会”开幕，2026年北京大视听“京琅琊”人才专项遴选结果正式公布，导演刘家成获评“京琅琊”名家人才。
items.content:
中新网11月27日电 11月26日，“2026北京国际视听大会”开幕，2026年北京大视听“京琅琊”人才专项遴选结果正式公布，导演刘家成获评“京琅琊”名家人才。

作为北京市广电视听行业高层次人才培养的重要举措，“京琅琊”人才专项是“北京大视听”人才体系建设的重要组成部分，着眼于发现、培养和凝聚广电视听行业高层次人才。其中，“名家人才”层次面向业界公认、成就突出、具有广泛影响力和行业引领作用的优秀人才。

从《铁齿铜牙纪晓岚》系列走入千家万户，到以“京味儿三部曲”——《傻春》《正阳门下》《情满四合院》深耕京味儿现实主义创作，再到《正阳门下小女人》《芝麻胡同》等作品持续拓展京味儿剧的表达空间，刘家成始终将镜头对准普通北京人的生活与命运，在烟火日常中记录北京的城市风貌，捕捉时代变迁与人情冷暖。

近年来，刘家成并未止步于熟悉的创作领域，而是不断拓展题材边界。从展现人民海军舰载机飞行员使命与担当的《海天雄鹰》，到描绘鲁南乡土生活、呈现普通农民命运与土地情感的《生万物》，再到家庭题材作品《好好的时光》，不同地域、不同年代、不同人物的故事，呈现出他不断突破自我、持续探索的创作热情。在第35届中国电视剧飞天奖上，刘家成凭借《生万物》《海天雄鹰》获得优秀导演奖，两部作品同时获得优秀电视剧奖。

对于北京，刘家成始终有着深厚的情感。北京不仅是他成长、生活和创作的地方，也是其艺术表达的重要根基。从胡同四合院到城市街巷，从普通市民的生活百态到时代发展中的人物命运，他以细致的生活观察和真诚的创作态度，记录北京的城市变迁，书写北京的人情温度，也让京味儿文化在当代荧屏上焕发出新的生命力。

刘家成曾谈到，地域是土壤，不是边界。对于创作者而言，重要的是找到一方土地与人物共同的精神气质，让真实、真诚的表达跨越地域与年龄的界限。这也构成了他不断拓展创作半径、探索不同题材的重要创作理念。

谈及未来创作，刘家成依然充满热情。接下来他计划创作一部展现“新北京”风貌的京味儿作品，将故事从传统的胡同大杂院延伸至当代北京的公寓、写字楼等城市生活空间，人物也不再局限于北京本地居民，而是将来自全国各地在北京生活、工作的人纳入叙事，展现这座城市在新时代的多元面貌。

“首都，是全国人民的首都。我想去写新老北京人的相遇、冲突、接纳、包容。不一定满屏京腔京韵，但北京这座城市的精神根魂不能丢。”

在颁奖环节，刘家成在发言中表示：“北京是我出生的地方，这里的人情烟火，我熟，我懂，所以未来十年的工作重心要放在北京，跟各位同行一道，讲好新时代北京的故事。”(完)

items.content:
中新网成都11月27日电 (单鹏)“珠玑玉佩的时光叙事”特展27日在成都博物馆启幕，展期将持续至2027年4月5日。本次特展由中国国家博物馆、成都博物馆联合推出，甄选中国国家博物馆馆藏620件(套)珠玉珍品，为成都观众展开一场跨越近万年的珠玉文明长卷。

在古代中国的艺术与审美体系中，珠玑玉佩堪称最具代表性的文化标识之一。从史前至春秋战国时期，珠饰与玉文化便深度交融。秦汉至元代，中国珠玉饰步入多元交融的繁盛阶段。及至明清，中国古典珠玉饰工艺达到精工繁丽的鼎盛阶段，庙堂的礼制追求与民间的生活意趣相互交融，共同铸就中国珠玉饰技艺与审美的巅峰。

据成都博物馆策划研究部副主任刘秋佚介绍，此次展出的620件(套)珠玉珍品，从新石器时代河姆渡文化的早期珠玉饰，到战国时期的云纹兽面绿松石饰，再到秦汉的玉具剑装饰、唐宋元的玉带饰，直至明代诗文玉牌与清代礼仪珠饰，时代相续，品类相承。透过这些温润灵动的珠玉，可以窥见中华文明的缩影。

众多展品中，陕西临潼姜寨遗址7号墓出土的骨珠串、绿松石坠饰，或为先民们祈求族群繁衍或丰产的道具；河南安阳殷墟妇好墓出土的骨笄和数量众多、种类丰富的珠玉饰品，象征着墓主人王后、军事统帅及王室大祭司的身份地位；元代的云龙纹饰件顶面雕琢云龙纹，饰件的四角采用内凹的海棠造型，是皇权至高无上的体现；宋代龙形玉饰、寓意吉祥的绶带蜻蜓佩饰、诗书画印与玉雕融合的梅花仕女诗文玉牌等珍贵文物，则体现了中国珠饰与玉文化“以器载道”的独特内涵。

items.summary: 中新网南宁11月27日电(俞靖 张广权)11月27日，“九州攸同——周秦汉唐文物特展”在广西壮族自治区博物馆开展。本次特展汇聚全国20家文博机构的164件(套)、共计280件珍贵文物，展期持续至2027年3月14日。
items.content:
中新网南宁11月27日电(俞靖 张广权)11月27日，“九州攸同——周秦汉唐文物特展”在广西壮族自治区博物馆开展。本次特展汇聚全国20家文博机构的164件(套)、共计280件珍贵文物，展期持续至2027年3月14日。

此次展品包含西周青铜礼器、秦代陶俑、汉代玉器、唐代金银器及三彩器等国宝重器，全方位展现周礼奠基、秦制一统、汉风远播、唐韵包容的文明演进历程。

作为聚焦“周秦汉唐”文明演进主线的专题大展，本次特展设置“周礼四方”“秦并六合”“汉兴天下”“唐汇万邦”四大单元，以跨区域文物联动为亮点，实现不同时代、不同类型的国宝重器同场对话，让参观者一次性纵览三千余年的华夏文明。

广西壮族自治区博物馆馆长陶少艺介绍，本次展览以“九州攸同”为主题，按“周秦汉唐”的时间顺序展开，旨在让参观者清晰理解中国如何从西周礼乐奠基，走向秦汉大一统发展，再到唐代多元文化交汇的历史进程。

陶少艺表示，希望观众在观展中感悟中华文明深厚底蕴，进一步厚植文化认同、坚定文化自信。

主办方介绍，本次特展设于广西壮族自治区博物馆陈列大楼二层5号展厅，免费对公众开放。广大市民、游客与文物爱好者可走进展厅，近距离观赏展出文物。(完)

items.summary: 中新网新余11月27日电 (王剑)动画电影《天工开物》发布会暨天工开物城市文旅联盟发起大会27日在江西省新余市举办。大会现场，新余联合上海徐汇，江苏苏州、江阴、宿迁，浙江嘉兴、桐乡，四川绵阳及江西南昌、赣州、九江等十余座影片取景关联地，正式发起天工开物城市文旅联盟。
items.content:
中新网新余11月27日电 (王剑)动画电影《天工开物》发布会暨天工开物城市文旅联盟发起大会27日在江西省新余市举办。大会现场，新余联合上海徐汇，江苏苏州、江阴、宿迁，浙江嘉兴、桐乡，四川绵阳及江西南昌、赣州、九江等十余座影片取景关联地，正式发起天工开物城市文旅联盟。

动画电影《天工开物》总导演陆川在发布会上表示，此前舞剧《天工开物》的全国巡演与海外传播，印证了该IP跨越时代、跨越圈层的文化感染力。相较于舞台艺术，动画电影拥有更广阔的大众传播空间，能够打破艺术壁垒，让老人、孩童都能读懂传统文化之美。

根据“天工开物城市文旅联盟”合作规划，各成员城市将依托影片取景资源，联合共建共享天工开物文旅IP，因地制宜打造电影取景打卡点、开发主题文创产品、制作打卡攻略与短视频素材，同步开展全域宣推，合力讲好“一部动画串联山河文脉”的文化故事。

据新余市文广旅局相关负责人介绍，该联盟将推出电影票根互认惠民机制，影片上映后，观众持有效观影票根，可在联盟各城市A级景区、非遗展馆、特色体验点位享受门票减免、消费折扣、专属体验礼包等福利，打通“观影—出游”消费链路。此外，联盟城市将深化客源互送、线路共推，结合亲子研学、周末休闲、文化探秘等市场需求，打造系列特色文旅线路，做大跨域文旅市场。

《天工开物》是中华古代文明的瑰宝。明代宋应星在新余分宜任教谕期间编撰完成的这部巨著，共三卷十八篇，收录一百三十余项工农业技术，配有一百二十三幅原创插图，被誉为“中国17世纪的工艺百科全书”。典籍不仅系统记录了农耕织造、矿石冶铸、车船制造等百工技艺，更承载着“贵五谷而贱金玉”的民生情怀、“取之有时、用之有度”的生态智慧和精益求精的工匠精神。(完)
